ftbquests.task.albionmastery.mastery_ran:
Whether to check the mastery rank or the Rank XP.
Rank XP = sum of all weapon levels × Rank XP per level (100 by default, configurable on the server).
Like other FTB tasks this counts for the whole team: one member meeting it completes it for everyone

≥ and > show a progress bar; =, ≤ and < are simply done or not done.
Once completed a task stays completed: "Rank = 0" completes as soon as a new player joins and stays done after they rank up.
Rank XP rises in batches (always a multiple of the Rank XP per level, sometimes several levels at once), so "Rank XP =" can be skipped and never complete. Use ≥ instead

For Rank, enter the rank number:
0 Unranked, 1 Initiate, 2 Silver Initiate, 3 Gold Initiate, 4 Novice ...
Every three ranks form a group (bronze, silver, gold): Novice, Disciple, Seeker, Hunter, Eagle, Tiger, Dragon, Sage,
28 Master, 29 Middle Master, 30 True Master, then 31 is Legendary 1, 32 Legendary 2 ...
For Rank XP, enter the amount: each weapon level gives 100 Rank XP by default,
rank 1 needs 2,500, rank 30 needs 2,250,000, and each Legendary rank needs another 147,500
Click to open the mastery screen
Rank XP is always a multiple of %s, so it never lands exactly on this target
Rank XP rises in batches and can skip straight past this value, so "=" may never complete. Use ≥ instead

config.albionmastery.mastery.tooltip: Gameplay values. The server's config is authoritative and is sent to clients for display
config.albionmastery.mastery.specializat:
Each weapon type (middle ring) has up to 4 slots (normal, breakthrough, normal, breakthrough). They apply once a weapon reaches its gate, and all slots stack.
Specializations are upgraded with mod points (Lv1-Lv5). At max normal level they break through with breakthrough points (★1-★5). The numbers in each section below are reference values: max normal level is 0.8x, max breakthrough 1.2x.
Every option has gains and costs. The first option of each source changes nothing.
All multipliers apply to the original value. For times, below 1 means faster
config.albionmastery.mastery.leaderboard:
Global leaderboard, opened from the bottom-left of the mastery screen.
Data is kept in the overworld save, so offline players stay on the board
config.albionmastery.mastery.sourceDamag:
Multiplies the mastery damage bonus of each weapon source (overall, type, weapon and synergy alike).
Default 1.0 keeps the normal strength
config.albionmastery.source_multiplier.t:
Mastery damage multiplier for %s (source ID: %s).
Default 1.0 keeps the normal strength
config.albionmastery.mastery.rank.toolti:
Account-wide progress modelled on Warframe's Mastery Rank.
Rank XP only comes from weapon (outer ring) levels. Ranks 1-30 need 2500 × rank squared in total, then every 147,500 is one Legendary rank.
Ranks are recomputed from weapon levels, so lowering the level cap or raising the XP curve can lower them
config.albionmastery.mastery.maxLevel.to: Mastery level cap, shared by all three rings
config.albionmastery.mastery.overallDama: Damage bonus per overall level for every weapon of that source (0.005 = 0.5%%)
config.albionmastery.mastery.typeDamageP: Damage bonus per type level for every weapon of that type (0.01 = 1%%)
config.albionmastery.mastery.weaponDamag: Damage bonus per weapon level for that weapon itself (0.02 = 2%%)
config.albionmastery.mastery.weaponXpMul:
Per-weapon mastery XP multipliers, one "weaponId=multiplier" per line. XP from fighting with that weapon is multiplied, and its type and source grow at the same rate. XP from commands is not.
See per-weapon damage multipliers for the ID format. Example: tacz:ak47=0.5
config.albionmastery.mastery.weaponDamag:
Per-weapon mastery damage bonus multipliers, one "weaponId=multiplier" per line, applied on top of the source multiplier.
Weapon ID: item ID for normal items; gun ID for TACZ guns (e.g. tacz:ak47); spell ID for Iron's Spells; blade ID for SlashBlade.
If an ID clashes between two sources, use the full weapon key (e.g. tacz_gun/tacz:ak47).
Hold the weapon and run /albionmastery info: the first line is the weapon key. Click it to copy. Example: tacz:m95=0.8
config.albionmastery.mastery.weaponCross: Damage bonus per weapon level for the other weapons of the same type (0.001 = 0.1%%)
config.albionmastery.mastery.maxTotalDam: Hard cap on a single weapon's total damage bonus (100.0 = +10000%%), only a safety net
config.albionmastery.mastery.xpBase.tool: XP curve base: XP to reach level L = round(xpBase * L ^ xpExponent)
XP curve exponent. Higher values slow late levels.
1.0 is linear. At 1.25, total XP to max level is about 2.8x that at 1.0
config.albionmastery.mastery.xpPerDamage:
Mastery XP per point of damage, counted before mastery bonuses.
Default 0: XP only comes from the experience mobs actually drop, so training dummies and tanky low-value mobs give nothing
config.albionmastery.mastery.xpPerKill.t: Flat mastery XP per kill regardless of the mob. Default 0
config.albionmastery.mastery.xpPerMobExp: Mastery XP per experience point the killed mob drops. Set to 0 for a flat kill reward only
config.albionmastery.mastery.xpFromOrigi:
true: use the experience the mob originally drops; false: use what drops after other mods changed it.
Mods that scale experience with mob level can inflate it many times, so the default is true
config.albionmastery.mastery.npcFallback:
For CustomNPCs, the drop experience set on the NPC (average of min and max) is used first.
This fallback is only used when that data can't be read. Has no effect without CustomNPCs
config.albionmastery.mastery.typeXpMulti:
XP needed per type level, relative to a single weapon.
3.0 means maxing a type takes 3 times the XP of maxing one weapon. Both receive the same XP per kill
config.albionmastery.mastery.overallXpMu: XP needed per overall (source) level, relative to one weapon
config.albionmastery.mastery.maxXpPerHit: Max XP from a single hit, so extreme damage setups can't farm XP
config.albionmastery.mastery.offhandXpRa:
Share of mastery XP the offhand weapon receives. The main hand gets full XP.
The same weapon in both hands only counts once
config.albionmastery.mastery.multiWeapon: When one item holds several weapons (an Iron's Spells spellbook with several spells), each gets this share of the kill XP. 1.0 = full
config.albionmastery.mastery.spellMaster:
Iron's Spells: share of the mastery bonus also turned into cooldown reduction.
Example: +40%% bonus with 0.3 gives 12%% shorter cooldowns. 0 disables it
Iron's Spells: share of the mastery bonus also turned into a mana cost discount, like cooldown share
Cooldown and mana reduction cap (0.5 = halved)
config.albionmastery.mastery.spellEffect:
Iron's Spells: spells whose effect durations are also extended by the mastery multiplier.
Only needed for spells whose duration depends on spell level rather than spell power (mostly from addons). Use spell IDs
Effect IDs that are never extended. Casting-state effects (ending in _cast / _loop, or containing casting / resource) are already skipped
config.albionmastery.mastery.netherXpMul: Mastery XP multiplier for kills in the Nether
config.albionmastery.mastery.endXpMultip: Mastery XP multiplier for kills in the End
config.albionmastery.mastery.moddedDimen: Mastery XP multiplier for kills in any dimension whose ID namespace isn't minecraft
config.albionmastery.mastery.dimensionXp:
Per-dimension multipliers that override all other rules.
One per line: dimensionID=multiplier, e.g. twilightforest:twilight_forest=1.8
config.albionmastery.mastery.shareFallof:
Share of kill XP each nearby player gets, indexed by the number of players.
First entry is for 1 player, second for 2, and so on. The last entry is reused beyond the table.
Only players holding a masterable weapon that isn't maxed count
config.albionmastery.mastery.nearbyShare: XP share radius in blocks, same dimension only
config.albionmastery.mastery.xpFromPlaye: Whether hitting players gives mastery XP. Turn off on PvE servers to prevent farming
config.albionmastery.mastery.syncInterva: Minimum interval between syncing mastery changes to the client, merging the many small updates from fast-firing weapons
config.albionmastery.mastery.splitMeleeB:
Whether LR Tactical melee weapons get one type per pack.
Changing this restarts melee type levels from zero. Weapon and overall levels are unaffected
config.albionmastery.mastery.npcExperien:
Multiplier applied to CustomNPCs drop experience before it is converted. Default 0.1.
An NPC with more than 1 experience always gives at least 1
config.albionmastery.mastery.specializat: When off, chosen specializations have no effect but stay in the save
Cooldown for switching specializations, in seconds (default 1 hour). Kept in memory only and reset on server restart

How many slots each weapon type has (1-4), taken in the order normal, breakthrough, normal, breakthrough.
Normal slots take the normal version (Lv1-Lv5), breakthrough slots the breakthrough version (★1-★5). One setup holds at most one per category.
With a single slot there is no breakthrough slot, so that slot uses the strongest version unlocked.
Slots stack: multipliers multiply, chances and ratios add, stacks take the larger

Percent of the level cap a weapon must reach before it benefits from its type's specializations (ranks can lower it, see rank reduction below).
Each weapon has its own gate and every slot requires it. Once the type reaches the bypass percent, the whole type skips the gate.
Slot 2 (breakthrough): type progress, in percent of the level cap, needed to open it. 0 = no requirement
Slot 3 (normal): source (inner ring) progress needed to open it. 0 = no requirement
Slot 4 (breakthrough): type progress needed to open it. 0 = no requirement
Once a type reaches this progress, every weapon of that type skips the slot 1 weapon gate. 0 = never

Scale of each normal level, comma separated. The value count sets the level count (up to 10).
The numbers in each specialization section are reference values: a scale of 0.2 moves 20%% of the way from unchanged to the reference, gains and costs alike.
By default the max normal level is 0.8x the reference
Scale of each breakthrough level, same rules. Breakthrough needs the normal version at max level. By default max breakthrough is 1.2x the reference
Mod points per normal level, comma separated. If shorter than the level count, the last value repeats
Breakthrough points per breakthrough level, same rules

Mod points (named per source: rework, trait, training points...) come from source level, one pool per source:
this many at max source level, linear in between, rounded down. Default 20 = one point every 5 levels.
Normal levels are shared across a source: a specialization at Lv3 for rifles is Lv3 for SMGs too
Rank bonus mod points: from this rank on, +1 for every source
Rank bonus mod points: another +1 every this many ranks
Rank bonus mod points: at most this many. 0 = off

Breakthrough points come from type level, one pool per type: this many at max type level, linear in between, rounded down.
Breakthroughs are per type: one done for rifles has to be done again with SMG points for SMGs
Extra breakthrough points for each maxed weapon in the type. 0 = none
Cap on the breakthrough points from maxed weapons
Rank lowers the slot 1 weapon gate starting at this rank
Rank reduction: one more step every this many ranks
Rank reduction: percent of the level cap removed per step (default 5 = 5 levels with a cap of 100). 0 = off
Rank reduction: at most this percent of the level cap
